cim: Power check? Why Anthropic could be the biggest loser from Jensen Huang’s return
cim_eredeti: Power check? Why Anthropic could be the biggest loser from Jensen Huang’s return
szoveg_eredeti:
Unlike most AI firms, Anthropic saw its share price dip on Monday, as reports emerged that Trump saw Huang as a check on the developer’s power

The divergent market reactions came as American media outlet Semafor reported on Monday that US President Donald Trump and Vice-President J.D. Vance had personally intervened to push for Huang’s reinstatement, including via a direct call from Trump to Nvidia’s board of directors.
